issues.description: Numeric threshold for Aufgabe 07 is inconsistent between the problem statement and the solution: the problem asks for Gemeinden with more than 75.000 (75,000) male or female inhabitants, but the solution uses a threshold of 7500 (seven thousand five hundred). This mismatch will cause students to produce or validate incorrect results and be confused about the intended cutoff.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the numeric constant in the solution to match the problem statement. Change the WHERE clause to use 75000 (seventy-five thousand) instead of 7500. For example: WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000
